inclusion_rule: Include distinct video publishing/distribution services with an officially documented route for an independent creator to reach an audience or accept payment; retain non-equivalence of formats and denominators.

dimensions.description: Long-form, short feed, livestream or paid OTT storefront
Official account, age, country, review, module, participation tiers
Engaged/qualified views, ads, live support, subscription, item purchases or direct customer sales
Who counts as qualified attention or paying customers; not platform-wide unique users
Creator rights, off-platform dependence, export, subscriber/customer relationships
Creator residence, payment-address country and currency account terms separately
Equipment, software, time, content rights, access fees, failed publishing work
Zero earners and inactive entrants must be included before comparative profitability

candidates.name: Twitch
candidates.comparable_youtube_surface: YouTube live streaming, memberships and fan support
candidates.earnings_mechanism: Bits/subscription support after appropriate setup; advertising only for eligible Affiliates/Partners under published tiers
candidates.eligibility_note: Different streamer monetization setup vs Affiliate/Partner and payout gate; terms as observed in 2026
candidates.limitations: Live-stream support and ad earnings cannot be converted into Shorts engaged-view RPM.

candidates.name: TikTok Creator Rewards
candidates.comparable_youtube_surface: YouTube Shorts, not long-form Watch Page ads
candidates.earnings_mechanism: Program rewards for eligible original videos at least one minute long and qualified For You views
candidates.eligibility_note: Official Help lists country, age, account, follower and view gates; availability and approval require separate evidence
candidates.limitations: Qualified For You views do not share definition or payout base with YouTube's public Shorts play starts.

candidates.name: Vimeo OTT
candidates.comparable_youtube_surface: YouTube external products, subscriptions and off-platform offers, not ad-supported public play counts
candidates.earnings_mechanism: Payments from customer content sales made through an OTT distribution offering
candidates.eligibility_note: Official help documents monthly sales payout; account setup, seller fees and offer types need separate verification
candidates.limitations: Sales receipts depend on customer acquisition and product prices; paying customers are not equivalent to public video viewers.

acceptance_gates.limitation: Comparison-set documentation does not constitute a creator income comparison
Product-level country restrictions and account decisions are not exhaustively verified
No source-aligned receipts, fees, working-time and cost distributions obtained
No cohorts including zero earners and inactive creators measured for multiple services

findings_scope: Official product-design taxonomy only; not evidence of relative creator income, success likelihood or net profit.
